color.note: Four brand blues (Cloud Blue, Bright Azure, Royal Blue, Midnight Navy) over neutral white and near-black ink. Light is the primary theme (marketing pages, cards, sheets); Navy is the in-app theme.

tokens.name: cloud-blue
tokens.usage: Brand: Cloud Blue. Icon wells, chips, the AI insight card tint.

tokens.name: bright-azure
tokens.usage: Brand: Bright Azure. Primary buttons in the app, active tab, step dots, the AI sparkle.

tokens.name: royal-blue
tokens.usage: Brand: Royal Blue. Links, badges, score ring, primary buttons on light pages.

tokens.name: midnight-navy
tokens.usage: Brand: Midnight Navy. App ground, splash screens, dark sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields and quiet chips.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Icon wells, AI insight card, selected chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control: input and outline-button edges, 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, amounts on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, meta lines and tab labels on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Overline labels such as PROJECT OVERVIEW. Source value, about 2.6:1 on surface in Light: use only at 14px+ uppercase for decoration, never for information.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and 'See all' on surface and surface-raised (at least 5.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill. Navy: white on Bright Azure is 3.3:1 in the source (passes only for large text); keep labels 16px medium or larger there.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Change badges (-18%, +12%) with on-action text.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: The AI sparkle and the 'AI insight' label.

tokens.name: notify
tokens.usage: Unread dot on the bell only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset.
